name: date_step invoice due-date demo
description: No sender/recipient filtering. Direct translation of the date_step example in docs/workflow.md: derives 'invoice_date' from the email's own Date header, derives 'due_date' as invoice_date + 7 days, then reuses both ${invoice_date}/${due_date} in save_attachment_step's destination/filename_template - proving date_step output flows into a later step's config via the same ${var} resolution used for magic variables like ${date}/${email_subject}. Also sets 'run_timestamp' from source=now with a custom strftime format to show a second, independent date_step in the same workflow (distinct output_var so they don't collide). Use with example-data/emails/invoice_report.eml (Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:00:00 +0000 -> invoice_date=2026-07-14, due_date=2026-07-21).
